verdict.rationale: Angular ships a first-party unit-test command (`ng test`, angular-docs-11), Signals-based reactive state (angular-docs-1), and dependency injection (angular-docs-2). Community commentary praises its testability and test support (angular-comm-7, angular-comm-9, angular-comm-15), and DI implies services and logic can be tested in isolation. Nothing in the evidence explicitly shows signals or logic being unit-tested without rendering components to the DOM. Missing for 10: documentation of testing signals/services without DOM rendering, a testing guide or API (e.g. TestBed or injection-context testing for signals), and recent hands-on corroboration for modern Angular rather than AngularJS-era comments.
